what_worked: Power-law concentration thesis is genuinely useful; data caveats slide shows honest analytical discipline.
fix_next: Replace every decorative AI illustration with actual data charts; fix misstated category medians and disordered section numbering.
verdict: Reasonable thesis buried under decorative filler, zero real charts, and several wrong numbers.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: total MRR $13.47M vs reference $15.60M (~$2.1M off). Slide 3: 19.7% zero-revenue vs reference 21.6% (216/1000). Slide 3: top-10 share stated 48% vs reference 49.6% (minor but rounded down). Slide 8: AI median $446 vs reference $503; Education median $2,142 vs reference $2,435; Marketing median $1,586 vs reference $2,369.50; Analytics median $1,294 vs reference $419 (3x overstatement). Slide 4: Stan $3.57M stated as 26.5% share implies total ~$13.47M, but reference total is $15.60M, making Stan's share closer to 22.9% if $3.57M is correct, or the $3.57M figure is wrong.

evidence.insight: Concentration/power-law framing (slides 3-4, 14) is the strongest original angle. AI overcrowding vs monetization contrast (slides 8, 13) is useful. B2B value gap is decision-relevant. But the same five points repeat across 4+ slides without deepening analysis.
evidence.narrative: Section numbering is disordered (01, 02, 03, 07, 05, 03 again, 10, 09) revealing unedited auto-generation. Same takeaways appear on slides 3, 4, 6, 8, 14, and 15 with near-identical wording. No progressive build or synthesis—just repetition.
evidence.framing: Title slide and exec summary clearly set audience (investment committee) and scope. Data caveats slide (11) is a genuine strength acknowledging missingness. However, MRR vs 30-day revenue is never clarified, and the deck conflates them throughout.
evidence.accuracy: Analytics median overstated 3x ($1,294 vs $419). Total revenue understated by ~$2.1M. Zero-revenue percentage off (19.7% vs 21.6%). Education and Marketing medians materially wrong. Stan's share internally inconsistent with stated total. Anonymous count 129 matches reference.
evidence.visual: Zero actual data visualizations in entire 15-slide deck. Every slide uses AI-generated decorative illustrations adding no analytical value. Slide 4 promises 'one chart' but shows none. Slide 10 donut rings misrepresent proportions. Slide 15 text overlaid on busy background is barely legible.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive AI-generated stock illustrations on nearly every slide. Gamma template with identical card layouts repeated. Consulting filler language ('moves the needle', 'wide-open opportunity'). Disordered section numbering reveals unedited auto-generation.

change_reason: Lowered accuracy from 4.5 to 4.0: Analytics median is 3x overstated ($1,294 vs $419), total revenue understated by $2.1M, and Stan share is internally inconsistent—these are material errors beyond rounding. Lowered narrative from 5.0 to 4.5: disordered section numbering and verbatim repetition across 4+ slides indicate unedited auto-generated structure. Other scores confirmed as appropriate.
